name: Contract from Below
description: (Tag:infernal)(Tag:meta)"Is it worth the price?" A worn blood-stained paper granting equal-rank Summon Demon without using an ability slot when signed in blood after offering 3 equal-level sacrifices (Abilities, Items, Familiars etc.; Skills excluded), e.g. a Rare Ability plus 2 Rare Items for Summon Demon (Rare). Single use upon signing; refundable for free to reclaim its ticket.
